changelog: - **A Gate set to pull all that stops because its own Pools are a little short now says why.** When such a Gate's Pools held less than its connections ask by only a tiny amount (more than 0.000000001, less than about 0.000001), the Gate stopped as it should, but its state said "Its outlet had no room left for it", even in a model with no capacity anywhere. It now says "Its all-or-nothing demand was not met", as it already did for a larger shortfall. A Gate that a full Pool holds back still gives the room as the reason. What moves is unchanged. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 22).
